digest.component_or_area: code-review overlay routing and test-trigger selection
propositions: The code-review tests overlay is selected only when a changed file matches test-path globs, missing changes that add declarations without modifying test files

A new helper _has_added_declaration fires when a diff contains added lines matching declaration keywords (def/class/fn/func/function) whose declared name is not also removed in the same file, and no changed file is under tests/ globs
The content_triggered_overlays function must accept a changed_files sequence to enable path-blind diff analysis with file-level provenance

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow blocking eligibility to coverage gaps concerning newly-introduced behaviour (added lines in diff) with named violating inputs (concrete values/arguments stated verbatim)
The detector is polyglot (Go, Rust, JS/TS, Python, Ruby) and portable by pure-text scanning with no CI provider or repository-layout assumptions
